groups.description: Live two-sided accommodation marketplaces this domain is modeled on — useful to see how traveler search and partner supply surfaces are positioned in practice.

links.title: Booking.com
links.relevance: The primary global accommodations-marketplace benchmark this domain is grounded in; shows the search, ranking, and checkout surface the leisure-traveler persona books against.

links.title: Expedia Group brands
links.relevance: Maps the multi-brand hotel, vacation-rental, and B2B lodging portfolio of a scaled global challenger — context for how the same supply graph serves leisure and managed-travel demand.

links.title: Airbnb
links.relevance: The dominant alternative-accommodations marketplace; the closest reference for how the home-host persona lists, prices, and manages non-hotel inventory.

groups.description: Primary-source company materials on how the accommodations marketplace operates and where its economics sit.

links.title: Booking.com — How we work
links.relevance: Explains ranking factors, payment models, and review handling that shape both the traveler conversion journey and partner visibility — a core source behind this domain's insights.

links.title: Booking Holdings — investor relations
links.relevance: Investor materials confirming accommodations as the largest commercial engine, anchoring the room-night and partner take-rate KPIs the partner persona is measured on.

groups.description: Resources aimed at hotels, alternative-accommodation hosts, and the connectivity partners that supply inventory programmatically.

links.title: List your property on Booking.com
links.relevance: The partner onboarding surface for hotels and home-hosts; grounds the host setup, first-booking-speed, and payout jobs-to-be-done for the accommodation-partner and home-host personas.

links.title: Booking.com Developers — Connectivity & Demand APIs
links.relevance: The availability, reservation, and inventory APIs that connectivity partners integrate against — context for the supply-scale and overbooking-risk capabilities behind the partner persona.

groups.description: How the platform frames booking trust and the consumer-protection rules that govern online accommodation marketplaces.

links.title: EU Digital Services Act — online platforms
links.relevance: The EU regime governing transparency, ranking disclosure, and trader verification on large platforms — directly shapes the trust, review, and partner-content controls in this domain.

links.title: EU Package Travel Directive
links.relevance: Defines traveler protection and refund obligations when accommodation is sold alongside other travel services — material to the checkout, cancellation, and connected-trip flows the traveler persona relies on.
